about_the_game:
Time always runs out. But what if you could try again?

In Ripley [Remembered], you play as Sage, a barista trapped in a looping day aboard a train bound for nowhere. Each loop brings new puzzles to solve, strange characters to meet, and unsettling truths to uncover. The passengers don’t know they’re repeating the same day. But you do.

To break the cycle, you'll need to:

  • Solve puzzles that persist through loops – Keep key items and knowledge across runs to open new paths and dialogue.

  • Decipher NPC routines – Timed events and tightly interwoven schedules create a reactive world that changes based on your actions.

  • Face psychological boss fights – Each fight is a manifestation of trauma, grief, or guilt, brought to life through surreal mechanics.

  • Unravel a deeply personal story – Themes of memory, loss, and perception are woven into every puzzle, fail state, and hidden file.

  • Dig deeper... if you dare – Some truths aren’t visible in-game...

This is a game about letting go, and the terrible beauty of holding on.
Some loops can’t be broken. But some can.

Features:

  • Interaction-Based Puzzle Gameplay – Every interaction moves the clock forward, forcing players to plan their actions wisely.

  • Bullet Hell Boss Fights – Intense, rhythmic battles reward players with new inventory items.

  • Psychological Narrative – A mystery about memory, loss, and identity unfolds with each loop.

  • Persistent Items & Progression – Certain items carry over between loops, unlocking new paths and possibilities.

  • Train Setting – A dreamlike train environment filled with unique NPCs hiding secrets.

content_descriptors.notes:
Mature topics such as grief, death, and general angst are discussed in detail.
Infrequent depictions of injured humans.

Minimum:

  • Graphics: 128MB

short_description: A surreal, story-driven puzzle game set on a train caught in a time loop. Solve narrative-driven puzzles, battle psychic bosses, and uncover the truth about memory, grief, and a girl named Ripley—before the day resets again.
